ClassifiedError.description:
Classified operational or domain error.

Distinguishes recoverable failures from permanent errors and maps
to the system error taxonomy without arbitrary tool or shell authority.

message.description: Safe diagnostic message without credentials or tokens
message.title: Message

recoverable.description: Whether this error category is eligible for bounded retry
recoverable.title: Recoverable

field_path.description: Optional field path if the error pertains to a specific field
field_path.title: Field Path

ClassifiedError.title: ClassifiedError

ErrorCategory.description: Classified error category for failure handling and recovery.
ErrorCategory.title: ErrorCategory

description:
C15 Pipeline Run Summary.

Summarizes the execution of a discovery, assessment, and sync pipeline run.
All counters have explicit documented units to prevent confusing source postings
with canonical jobs.

status.description: Overall run status: success, partial, or failed

source_counts.description: Map of source_key -> count of source postings observed
source_counts.title: Source Counts

source_postings_count.description: Total source postings observed across all sources in this run
source_postings_count.title: Source Postings Count

canonical_jobs_new.description: Count of newly discovered canonical jobs registered
canonical_jobs_new.title: Canonical Jobs New

canonical_jobs_updated.description: Count of existing canonical jobs that received new revisions
canonical_jobs_updated.title: Canonical Jobs Updated

canonical_jobs_duplicate.description: Count of postings identified as duplicates of existing canonical jobs
canonical_jobs_duplicate.title: Canonical Jobs Duplicate

eligible_count.description: Count of canonical jobs classified as eligible
eligible_count.title: Eligible Count

review_count.description: Count of canonical jobs flagged for candidate review
review_count.title: Review Count

rejected_count.description: Count of canonical jobs classified as rejected
rejected_count.title: Rejected Count

sync_operations_succeeded.description: Count of sync operations successfully delivered to Salesforce
sync_operations_succeeded.title: Sync Operations Succeeded

sync_operations_failed.description: Count of sync operations that failed delivery
sync_operations_failed.title: Sync Operations Failed

errors.description: Classified errors encountered during the run
errors.title: Errors

pending_work.description: Descriptions of deferred or retry-waiting items
pending_work.title: Pending Work

title: RunSummary
